source.name: Liquipedia
source.method: the Elo of every map of Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and Counter-Strike 2 in Liquipedia's S-, A- and B-Tier 5v5 events from 2012-09-21 to the end of 2024 (docs/design/counter-strike.md, "Earlier seasons")
source.conversion: rating = Elo / 25 − 2, rounded; each newcomer started at his region's level as the maps to 2024-12-31 measure it (AF 1205, ASIA 1306, CIS 1537, EU 1500, MENA 1271, NA 1344, OCE 1302, SA 1458; fitted at once with every player's own strength, Europe's at 1,500: docs/design/counter-strike.md, "Regions")
